summary.zh-CN: 增强主侧栏固定入口与市场兼容提示，并对发布产物补充可校验的 UI 压缩副本，降低首次更新后的首屏压力。
summary.en-US: Refine main sidebar pinned entries and marketplace compatibility feedback, and publish validated compressed UI assets as part of stable runtime packages.

body.zh-CN: 固定到主侧栏的应用现在可以按分组展示，提升窄栏使用下的可达性。
body.en-US: Pinned Panel Apps can now be grouped in the main sidebar for better discoverability in narrow layouts.

body.zh-CN: 市场应用列表会显示当前设备是否支持该应用以及不支持原因，避免误点和重复重试。
body.en-US: Marketplace listings now expose whether an app is supported on the current device and the specific unsupported reason.

title.zh-CN: 统一服务应用启动路径

body.zh-CN: 桌面端声明 `node` / `node.exe` 的应用统一使用 NextClaw 内置 Node，降低系统环境差异导致的启动失败概率。
body.en-US: Desktop Service Apps that declare `node` or `node.exe` now run on the Node runtime bundled with NextClaw.

body.zh-CN: 不再将历史安装失败作为全局持续错误显示，避免在其他操作中反复展示。
body.en-US: Incompatible install failures are now scoped to the app card instead of becoming a global sticky error state.

body.zh-CN: `ui-dist` 发布构建会生成并校验 gzip sidecar，以便静态部署层直接复用压缩资产。
body.en-US: `ui-dist` packaging now generates and validates gzip sidecars so static deployment layers can serve precompressed assets directly.
